name: Reckon — Orchestrator
description: Unified Reckon orchestrator: PDF export (WSL pipeline + native print fallback), blueprint engine (Nunjucks), trail-refs with bearings, annotations → MCP loop, compass overlay (mermaid built-in; ExcaliBrain optional), dependency doctor, MCP bridge side panel, vendored Breadcrumbs + Dataview subsets, visual-language callouts, QuickAdd macros. One plugin, zero mandatory peers (Excalidraw + ExcaliBrain are optional). Turns the vault into a creative cognitive substrate.
author: goodoleusa / Persistech
